style_reason: 草莓红润圆实，S1 水彩蜡笔大留白最能突出清新感

hero.name: 草莓
hero.states: whole + one halved showing juicy red interior with tiny pale seeds

secondary.name: 薄荷叶
secondary.place: 贴在白瓷浅碟边缘、距主体1身位内
secondary.note: 比主体小且柔、清新浅绿点缀

secondary.name: 蓝莓
secondary.place: 散落在主体左前白瓷碟内、近距点散
secondary.note: 更小更柔、深蓝与红绿呼应

props: a white ceramic shallow bowl on light linen cloth

palette.overall: 暖米白托底、整体中低饱和

views.compose: 居中对称、主体居中偏下、上方大留白
views.pv_en: three-quarter high-angle view, centered symmetrical composition with generous margins; exactly 3 fresh strawberries as the hero, one halved revealing juicy red interior with tiny pale seeds, the whole ones glossy with natural sheen and green leafy calyx, subtle organic irregularity in size and orientation; exactly 2 small mint leaves placed at the rim of the white bowl within one body-length of the hero, softer and lighter in tone; exactly 3 small blueberries scattered closely in the same bowl, clearly smaller and dimmer; held in a white ceramic shallow bowl on light linen cloth; warm ivory textured paper background with one pale color-wash; soft diffused near-flat light, no hard shadow; hero occupies center frame and is the only focal point, all props visibly receding and softened

views.compose: 三分偏心、主体偏左下、右上整片留白
views.pv_en: straight top-down flat-lay view, rule-of-thirds off-center composition with large clean negative space on the upper right; exactly 3 fresh strawberries clustered at the lower left as the hero, one halved showing a juicy red cross-section with tiny pale seeds, the whole ones glossy with green leafy calyx and gentle natural variation; exactly 2 small mint leaves tucked at the bowl rim beside the hero, lighter and softer green; exactly 3 small blueberries scattered loosely within one body-length, dimmer and smaller; arranged in a white ceramic shallow bowl on light linen cloth; warm ivory textured paper background with one pale color-wash; soft diffused near-flat light, no hard shadow; hero is clearly the largest and most vivid element, all props receding and softened
